title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_pourquoi_m_ont_ils_fait_ca_by_anya_peters_b3j2t (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_pourquoi_m_ont_ils_fait_ca_by_anya_peters_b3j2t' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or run.
